title: Symbolism & the Pre-Raphaelites
description: Dreamlike myth, doomed romance, and veiled mystery from the later 19th century.
source: Art Institute of Chicago, Wikimedia Commons

items.title: Ophelia
items.description_narrative: A young woman floats on her back in a slow stream, hair fanned in the water, flowers drifting around her amid dense overhanging foliage. John Everett Millais painted the scene in 1851 for the Pre-Raphaelite Brotherhood, depicting Ophelia's drowning from Hamlet; it hangs in Tate Britain.
items.tags: pre-raphaelite, ophelia, shakespeare, tragedy, nature, oil painting

items.title: Christ in the House of His Parents
items.description_narrative: A carpenter examines a small cut on a child's palm while the boy's mother kneels to comfort him, their faces close together, in a workshop scattered with curling wood shavings. Tools hang on the wall, a ladder leans behind the bench, and a flock of sheep is visible through the open doorway.
items.tags: pre-raphaelite, oil on canvas, carpenter's workshop, millais, religious art, domestic interior
items.credit_line: Google Arts & Culture — KgHTjZxC7spFMQ Tate Images (http://www.tate-images.com/results.asp?image=N03584&wwwflag=3&imagepos=1)

items.title: Proserpine
items.description_narrative: A woman with masses of curling auburn hair holds a partly eaten reddish fruit close to her chest, her deep green drapery folding heavily around her. A trailing ivy vine climbs the wall behind her, and a small brass lamp sends up a thin curl of smoke on the ledge below.
items.tags: pre-raphaelite, oil on canvas, rossetti, portrait, ivy, green drapery
items.credit_line: JQFW5c2ZLfpmbw at Google Cultural Institute, zoom level maximum

items.title: Beata Beatrix
items.description_narrative: A woman in green sits with her eyes closed and head tilted back as if in a trance, her hands open in her lap. A red bird drops a white poppy into her palms, while two faint figures, one in red, linger in a hazy background where a sundial glows with light.
items.tags: pre-raphaelite, oil on canvas, symbolism, rossetti, portrait, trance
items.credit_line: Google Arts & Culture — GgHmtzXziFIlnQ Tate Images (http://www.tate-images.com/results.asp?image=N01279&wwwflag=3&imagepos=1)

items.title: The Day Dream
items.description_narrative: A woman in a flowing green gown sits nestled in the bough of a leafy tree, pausing mid-thought with a small flowering branch held loosely in one hand. A closed book rests open on her lap, a single blossom tucked between its pages, while dense foliage wraps around her on every side.
items.tags: pre-raphaelite, oil on canvas, rossetti, portrait, tree, green drapery
items.credit_line: cAH3bOzjJ3e7Dg at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Lady Lilith
items.description_narrative: A woman with a great cascade of loose, wavy hair brushes it out while gazing into a small hand mirror, seemingly absorbed in her own reflection. White and pink roses bloom densely behind her, and lit candles stand on a dressing table beside an open window showing trees outside.
items.tags: pre-raphaelite, oil on canvas, rossetti, mirror, roses, dressing table

items.title: The Awakening Conscience
items.description_narrative: A woman rises suddenly from a man's lap at the piano, her face turned toward a garden glimpsed through an open window and reflected in the mirror behind her. Beneath the table a cat toys with a trapped bird, a small, unsettling echo of the scene playing out above it on the richly patterned carpet.
items.tags: pre-raphaelite, oil on canvas, victorian interior, allegory, domestic scene, symbolism
items.credit_line: Google Arts & Culture — eAEe8oI1HIMufA Tate Images (http://www.tate-images.com/results.asp?image=T02075&wwwflag=3&imagepos=1)

items.title: The Golden Stairs
items.description_narrative: A long procession of young women in pale, flowing robes winds down a tall spiral staircase, so alike in face and dress that they read almost as one figure repeated. Several carry musical instruments, cymbals, a trumpet, a violin, though no single gesture breaks the quiet, unhurried rhythm of the descent.
items.tags: pre-raphaelite, oil on canvas, burne-jones, procession, spiral staircase, musicians

items.title: The Beguiling of Merlin
items.description_narrative: A woman in shimmering blue drapery reads from an open book while a man behind her, wide-eyed and still, appears trapped within the twisting branches of a blossoming tree. Neither figure meets the viewer's gaze, and the dense flowering foliage presses in from every side.
items.tags: pre-raphaelite, oil on canvas, symbolism, burne-jones, enchantment, blossoming tree
items.credit_line: Scanned from Wildman, Stephen: Edward Burne-Jones: Victorian Artist-Dreamer, Metropolitan Museum of Art, 1998, ISBN 0870998595
items.current_repository: Lady Lever Art Gallery, Port Sunlight (National Museums Liverpool)

items.title: King Cophetua and the Beggar Maid
items.description_narrative: A man in dark armor sits on a lower step, cradling a golden crown in his lap and gazing up at a barefoot woman in a plain gray dress seated above him. Two figures lean over a balcony rail behind them, watching the pair from within a richly carved, shadowed interior.
items.tags: pre-raphaelite, oil on canvas, burne-jones, crown, armor, interior

items.title: The Lady of Shalott
items.description_narrative: A woman in flowing white sits at the edge of a small boat draped in an embroidered tapestry, her lips parted and eyes distant as she drifts among the reeds. Three candles stand at the prow, and dense autumn trees close in around the quiet water on every side.
items.tags: pre-raphaelite, oil on canvas, waterhouse, boat, river scene, tapestry
items.credit_line: Google Arts & Culture — RQHFwa4u2LTw0g Tate Images (http://www.tate-images.com/results.asp?image=N01543&wwwflag=3&imagepos=2)

items.title: Hylas and the Nymphs
items.description_narrative: A young man kneels at the edge of a lily-covered pool, a water jug still in one hand, as several bare-shouldered women rise from among the leaves and blossoms to surround him. One gently grips his wrist, drawing him toward the water while he leans forward, seemingly unaware of the danger.
items.tags: mythological painting, oil on canvas, waterhouse, pre-raphaelite, water nymphs, lily pond

items.title: Ophelia
items.description_narrative: A young woman with long auburn hair sits by a lily-covered pond, one hand raised to her throat, red flowers tucked in her hair as loose petals drift over the embroidered hem of her pale gown. John William Waterhouse is credited as the artist of this depiction of Ophelia.
items.tags: ophelia, pre-raphaelite, shakespeare, waterhouse, melancholy, symbolism

items.title: The Magic Circle
items.description_narrative: A dark-haired woman traces a wide circle in the dirt with a wand-like stick, a bronze cauldron beside her sending a straight column of smoke into the sky. Crows and ravens perch and gather nearby, a skull lies half-buried in the sand, and a small frog crouches at the edge of the circle.
items.tags: symbolism, oil on canvas, waterhouse, sorceress, cauldron, ravens

items.title: Work
items.description_narrative: Beneath an arched top edge, a crowded street bustles with life: laborers dig a trench in the middle of the road while a barefoot flower seller, riders on horseback, children, dogs, and two well-dressed men in top hats all share the same narrow strip of pavement, each absorbed in a different errand.
items.tags: pre-raphaelite, oil on canvas, ford madox brown, street scene, social realism, victorian
items.credit_line: 1QG5Dp3Ti29BxA at Google Cultural Institute, zoom level maximum

items.title: The Last of England
items.description_narrative: A man in a wide-brimmed hat and a woman in a pink-lined bonnet sit pressed together on a crowded, rocking boat, her hand gripped tightly in his beneath her shawl. Painted within a round frame, the scene shows white cliffs receding in the distance and other passengers, including a small child, crowded around them.
items.tags: pre-raphaelite, oil on panel, ford madox brown, emigration, sea voyage, tondo

items.title: The Apparition
items.description_narrative: An elaborately jeweled dancer points toward a severed, bleeding head that hovers in a blaze of radiating light inside an ornate palace hall. Watching figures crowd the margins, dwarfed by the intricate carved architecture and the eerie glow at the center of the room.
items.tags: symbolism, watercolor, gustave moreau, vision, ornate architecture, religious art
items.credit_line: 8wHHpSOCxyjnIg at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Jupiter and Semele
items.description_narrative: A radiant, crowned figure sits enthroned within an overwhelming mass of carved ornament, while a nude woman sinks against his knees, her body going limp. A dark winged creature crouches below the throne, and dozens of smaller figures crowd every margin of the composition in jewel-like detail.
items.tags: symbolism, oil on canvas, gustave moreau, enthroned figure, ornate composition, mythological painting

items.title: Oedipus and the Sphinx
items.description_narrative: A winged creature with a woman's head and a lion's body clings to a nude man's chest, its claws gripping his skin while he holds a spear and meets its gaze without flinching. Scattered human remains lie at the base of a rocky ledge, and a carved funerary urn stands on a column beside them.
items.tags: mythological painting, oil on canvas, gustave moreau, sphinx, spear, rocky landscape

items.title: The Cyclops
items.description_narrative: A single enormous eye stares out from a mass of bristling, hair-like texture, set above a grinning mouth full of teeth. Rendered entirely in black, white, and gray, the image has the scratchy, granular texture of a print rather than the smooth surface of paint.
items.tags: symbolism, print, odilon redon, monster, grotesque, monochrome
items.credit_line: This file was donated to Wikimedia Commons as part of a project by the National Gallery of Art. Please see the Gallery's Open Access Policy.
items.current_repository: Prints in the National Gallery of Art

items.title: Isle of the Dead
items.description_narrative: A small rocky island crowned with tall, dark cypress trees rises from still water, its cliffs cut with tomb-like openings. A rowboat approaches carrying a white-shrouded standing figure beside a pale, coffin-shaped object, the whole scene lit by a faint, otherworldly glow against the dark sky.
items.tags: symbolism, oil on panel, böcklin, island, cypress trees, funerary scene
items.credit_line: 1. Unknown sourceUnknown source2. Bridgeman Art Library: Object 838233. Kunstmuseum Basel, online collection

items.title: The Poor Fisherman
items.description_narrative: A bearded man stands with hands clasped in a small moored boat, his head bowed, while two children play on the grassy bank nearby, one crouched low, the other leaning forward. Rendered in soft, sketch-like tones, the scene has a quiet, unfinished intimacy.
items.tags: symbolism, fisherman, boat, children, sketch-like tones, riverbank

items.title: Flaming June
items.description_narrative: A woman sleeps curled tightly into herself, wrapped head to foot in vivid, sunlit orange drapery that fills nearly the entire canvas. A flowering branch and a glimpse of open sea beyond a marble ledge are the only other elements, leaving the sleeping figure and her brilliant color the whole subject.
items.tags: symbolism, oil on canvas, leighton, sleeping figure, aestheticism, orange drapery

items.title: The Roses of Heliogabalus
items.description_narrative: A vast cascade of pink and white rose petals pours down from a hidden panel above, half-burying reclining feasters below in drifts of color. Beyond the petal-storm, more guests lean over a flower-strewn table beneath marble columns, seemingly unaware of what is about to bury them.
items.tags: symbolism, oil on canvas, alma-tadema, roman banquet, rose petals, marble columns

items.title: Circe Invidiosa
items.description_narrative: A woman in dark, scale-patterned drapery stands over turquoise water, her face intent as she pours a stream of vivid, glowing green liquid from a shallow bowl into the sea below. The unnaturally bright green against the deep teal water gives the whole scene a poisonous, otherworldly glow.
items.tags: mythological painting, oil on canvas, pre-raphaelite, waterhouse, sorceress, sea
items.credit_line: ZwGeGjQ7_fwYxQ at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Hope
items.description_narrative: A blindfolded woman in a pale, flowing robe sits atop a globe, head bowed as she plucks the single remaining string of a battered lyre. Painted in oil on panel by George Frederic Watts in 1891, this smaller version is held at the Yale Center for British Art.
items.tags: symbolism, watts, allegory, hope, blindfold, lyre, oil on panel

items.title: The Caress (Les Caresses)
items.description_narrative: A spotted creature with a woman's head and a leopard's sinuous body presses its cheek against a bare-chested young man, who grips a staff topped with a blue orb. Hieroglyph-like marks cover the wall behind them, and the desert stretches flat and reddish toward the horizon.
items.tags: symbolism, oil on canvas, belgian art, sphinx-like creature, androgyny, desert landscape
items.credit_line: _AGlYSd0kETwGw at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level
items.current_repository: Royal Museums of Fine Arts of Belgium

items.title: The Wheel of Fortune
items.description_narrative: A tall figure draped in metallic gray robes turns a massive wheel, to which three nude men cling at different heights, chained and helpless as it revolves. One near the top wears a crown, another lower down a laurel wreath, their positions marking a slow, silent rise and fall.
items.tags: symbolism, oil on canvas, burne-jones, allegory, wheel, chained figures
items.credit_line: xgFTGwg3Eu3-wg at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Echo and Narcissus
items.description_narrative: A young man leans over a still woodland pool, transfixed by his own reflection among the water lilies, while a woman in pink drapery watches unseen from behind a tree just a few feet away. Yellow iris grow at the water's edge, and neither figure seems aware of the other's presence.
items.tags: mythological painting, oil on canvas, waterhouse, pre-raphaelite, reflection, woodland pool

items.title: Madonna
items.description_narrative: A nude woman stands with eyes closed and head tilted back, dark hair streaming loose around her shoulders beneath a thin red halo. Swirling, undulating brushstrokes of blue, green, and brown fill the background, giving the whole figure a restless, almost underwater movement.
items.tags: symbolism, oil on canvas, edvard munch, expressionism, portrait, halo
items.credit_line: National Museum of Art, Architecture and Design

items.title: Elaine
items.description_narrative: A woman lies motionless on an embroidered cloth aboard a funeral barge draped in garlands of pink and white flowers, while a hooded figure poles the boat across still, twilight water. A small crucifix rises at the prow, and a lone white bird crosses the darkening sky above.
items.tags: symbolism, oil on canvas, victorian, funeral barge, twilight, river scene

items.title: Winged Figure
items.description_narrative: A winged woman sits with eyes closed and hands folded against her chest, resting back against clouds and the sweep of her own outstretched wing. The pale gold of her drapery stands out softly against a deep blue sky filled with drifting clouds.
items.tags: symbolism, oil on canvas, abbott handerson thayer, winged figure, portrait, clouds

items.title: Apollo and Marsyas
items.description_narrative: Two nude youths face each other in a grove of tall, dark cypresses, one holding a lyre, the other raising a double flute to his lips. The trees stand in stiff, vertical rows like columns, giving the quiet confrontation the hush of a temple.
items.tags: mythological painting, oil on panel, symbolism, cypress trees, musical contest, german art
items.credit_line: 1. terminartors.com2. Art Institute of Chicago via Web archive3. saic.smugmug.com

items.title: Cleopatra
items.description_narrative: A woman in white robes and a gold crown reclines against a leopard-print cushion, one hand resting on a carved lion-headed armrest, before a wall decorated with a winged Egyptian motif. The image is printed with a wide border and a caption beneath it, evidence this reproduction was issued as a collectible plate rather than shown as the original canvas.
items.tags: symbolism, print reproduction, waterhouse, egyptian motif, portrait, ancient egypt

items.title: Saint Cecilia
items.description_narrative: A woman sits with eyes closed in an ornately carved chair, an open book resting on her lap, as two winged figures beside her play violins among blooming rose bushes. Ships lie anchored in a harbor visible beyond the garden wall, framed by distant hills.
items.tags: symbolism, oil on canvas, waterhouse, musicians, garden, harbor view

items.title: A Song of Springtime
items.description_narrative: A woman gathers yellow and blue wildflowers into the folds of her white dress while a child beside her plays a small flute. Further off, more children crouch and pick flowers among blossoming trees, with a stretch of blue coastline visible in the distance.
items.tags: symbolism, oil on canvas, waterhouse, spring, wildflowers, children

items.title: Lamia
items.description_narrative: A woman in a dress patterned like serpent scales kneels before an armored knight seated on a stone slab in a shadowy forest clearing, her hands clasped over his. John William Waterhouse painted this depiction of Lamia in 1905; it hangs in the Auckland Art Gallery.
items.tags: waterhouse, lamia, keats, serpent woman, symbolism, pre-raphaelite, knight, mythology
items.credit_line: 7QFhMm-f-tY5SA at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level
items.current_repository: Auckland Art Gallery Toi o Tāmaki

items.title: Diogenes
items.description_narrative: A bearded old man sits inside a huge terracotta jar, holding a scroll, while young women in colorful classical dress peer down at him from marble steps above, one leaning over the wall with open curiosity. A small lantern rests on the ground nearby, unlit in the bright Mediterranean sun.
items.tags: symbolism, oil on canvas, waterhouse, classical scene, marble steps, ancient greece
items.credit_line: PQF2Xwtgk0c2tw at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level
items.current_repository: Art Gallery of New South Wales

items.title: The Rescue
items.description_narrative: A figure stretched flat along a stone ledge reaches a long stick down into a pool to retrieve a cluster of red flowers floating on the water. A woman in white, draped with a turquoise beaded necklace, watches from the courtyard steps above, a large terracotta jar resting nearby.
items.tags: symbolism, oil on canvas, waterhouse, courtyard, pool, flowers

items.title: La Belle Dame Sans Merci
items.description_narrative: A knight in full armor bends close over a barefoot woman seated among wildflowers in a dim forest, her hand winding a cord or scarf around his neck as she draws him toward her. Bare tree trunks rise on every side, and a patch of water glints faintly through the woods behind them.
items.tags: pre-raphaelite, oil on canvas, waterhouse, knight, forest, enchantment

items.title: Lady on a Balcony, Capri
items.description_narrative: A woman leans over the whitewashed parapet of a rooftop balcony, looking down toward the street below, half shaded by a leafy vine trellis overhead. The sun-bleached walls, arched doorway, and potted greenery below give the scene the simple geometry of a Mediterranean hillside town.
items.tags: symbolism, oil on canvas, waterhouse, balcony, mediterranean architecture, vine trellis

items.title: A Tale from the Decameron
items.description_narrative: A group of women in richly colored gowns sit together on the grass, listening intently to a man in a red cap who gestures as he speaks. A discarded lute lies nearby and a stone fountain rises behind them in a walled garden, where two more figures stroll in the distance.
items.tags: symbolism, oil on canvas, waterhouse, garden, storytelling, medieval dress

items.title: The Favourites of the Emperor Honorius
items.description_narrative: A seated man in rich red robes feeds a plate of grain to a flock of doves and pigeons crowding the marble floor around his feet, entirely absorbed in the birds. Behind him, a line of robed courtiers bow low in the background, ignored, while a man beside a column raises a banner overhead.
items.tags: symbolism, oil on canvas, waterhouse, roman interior, doves, courtiers
items.credit_line: ygFWM4YTEcusUg at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level
